{{Quote|All right, that's enough big fella!|The trooper to Bossk|<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>}}
A '''clone''' served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] with [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. He was stationed at the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disguised himself as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] and infiltrated the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center to uncover a plot to assassinate [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], this [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was on guard in the detention facility's mess hall along with many other clone shock trooper guards.

After the undercover [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] became involved in a fight with fellow prisoner [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], two troopers tried to stop them but were overpowered by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] prisoner [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]. Moments after, this trooper and three others arrived and tried to subdue Bossk, but failed, and a [[Riot at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|prison riot]] ensued.

==Behind the scenes==
The clone first appeared in the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] television series' fourth season, titled "[[Deception]]." He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], the actor who portrays all of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers in the series.
